title: Evasion
wikitext:
{{Distinguish|Dodge}}
'''Evasion''' is the [[Receiving damage|first layer]] of [[defence]] that affects a [[character]]'s chance to evade incoming [[attack]]s. Evasion is opposed by the attacker's [[accuracy]]. Evasion is one of the four core defences that can appear locally on [[equipment]], along with [[armour]], [[energy shield]] and [[ward]].

All [[classes]] start with 15 base evasion rating. Gaining a level does not implicitly grant an increase to evasion.<ref>[[Version 3.15.0#Character Balance]]</ref>. 

[[Dexterity]] grant a bonus to evasion. Every 5 points of dexterity grants {{c|mod|1% increased Evasion Rating}}. Values of dexterity that are not multiples of 5 will be rounded up to the nearest multiple of 5 (e.g. 141 dexterity will be rounded to 145).

==Mechanics==
Evasion prevents [[hit]]s by [[attack]] skills. [[Spell]]s cannot be evaded. The chance to evade an attack is based on the defender's evasion rating, though the actual chance to be hit by an attack also depends on the attacker's accuracy. Because [[accuracy|chance to hit]] cannot be lower than 5%, chance to evade cannot exceed 95%. 

{{math|formula=
\text{Chance to Evade} = 1 - {\text{Attacker's Accuracy}*1.25 \over \text{Attacker's Accuracy} + (\text{Defender's Evasion} \times \frac{1}{5}) ^ {0.9} }
}}<ref name="cite4"/>

There are two [[modifiers]] which bypass evasion:  {{c|mod|Cannot Evade enemy Attacks}} (from for example the [[Unwavering Stance]] keystone or {{Il|Ezomyte Peak}}), and attacks using [[Hits can't be evaded]].

Evasion also gives an implicit chance to not receive [[critical strike]]s from attacks.<ref name="cite1"/> If an incoming critical strike hit succeeds the initial hit/miss roll, a secondary check is performed to determine if it is a critical strike. If the first roll succeeds but the second roll fails, the non-crit damage is applied. Spell critical strikes ignore evasion.

Evasion does not calculate the chance of each hit independently. Instead, it uses a deterministic "entropy" based system to ensure that enemies won't get long strings of hits or misses by chance.<ref name="cite1"/> To summarize, these are the calculation steps in each attack:
# If it is the first time an entity is attacked, or if the time between the last attack and this one is larger than 100 server ticks (3.33 seconds), randomize the entropy value from 0–99.[[File:EvasionPlot.png|alt=Evade chance as a function of Evasion Rating and Attacker Accuracy.  Monsters at level 84 (Tier 16 Maps) have been highlighted.|thumb|375x375px|Evade chance as a function of Evasion Rating and Attacker Accuracy.  Monsters at level 84 (Tier 16 Maps) have 538 accuracy.]]
# Calculate chance to hit of the attacker using the above formula, and add this integer to the entropy value.
# If resulted entropy value is lower than 100 the hit counts as '''evade'''. When the value gets increased to 100 or greater, the check counts as a '''hit''', and entropy value is subtracted by 100.
# A critical hit is evaded on a separate random roll and will not affect entropy.
{{cot|Examples}}
====Example====
A player is fighting three monsters, one (A) with a 70% chance to hit and two (B, C) with a 45% chance to hit. 
*A attacks. The player's entropy value is a random number between 0-99, in this case '''37'''.
*A adds 70 to the counter, raising it to 100 or greater, and hits. 100 is subtracted and the entropy is now at '''7'''.
*B attacks, adding 45. '''52'''
*C attacks, adding 45. '''97'''
*A attacks, adding 70. This hits and the entropy becomes '''67'''. It happens to be a critical strike, which means it has a 70% chance to do bonus damage. This roll is independent and doesn't affect entropy.
*The player runs away for >6 seconds, so a new entropy value will be rolled on the next attack.
{{cob}}
As a result, if a player has a 1 in N chance to be hit, then the player will be hit exactly once for every N consecutive attacks. This eliminates all possibilities of lucky and/or unlucky streaks. It is still based on chance because of the entropy's value randomization in the first step. Note that if multiple mobs are attacking one character, all of the mobs' attacks share the same entropy value.<ref name="cite2"/> Also note that the chance to evade calculation on the character page is based on the average accuracy of a monster at the player's level.

===Interaction with Avoidance===
{{c|mod|Chance to Avoid X Damage}} is separate from evasion and chance to hit, and does not contribute to the calculation. As avoidance still is considered taking a hit, the evasion roll occurs prior to avoidance.

===Modifiers to chance to hit and chance to evade===
Certain modifiers apply directly to the {{c|mod|Chance to Hit}} and {{c|mod|Chance to Evade}} stats, such as {{c|mod|+(5-8)% chance to Evade Attack Hits while affected by Grace}} from {{il|Watcher's Eye}}. These modifiers are unaffected by modifiers to Accuracy or Evasion Rating, but will be scaled by modifiers to Chance to Hit/Chance to Evade.

==Mechanics Scaled by Evasion Rating==
===Unique Items===
The following items provide some bonuses that scale with evasion rating.

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
  item_stats.id LIKE "%per%evasion%"
|large=1
|stat=1
|level=1
}}

===Mods===
{{modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats, spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where=
 mod_stats.id LIKE "%Evasion%cappe%"
 AND generation_type NOT IN (3)
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|generation_type=1
|domain=1
}}

==Related items==
===Flasks===
{{Drop enabled base item table
|where=items.class_id="UtilityFlask" AND item_buffs.stat_text LIKE "%Evasion%"
|large=1
|level=1
|flask=1
|buff=1
|stat=1
}}

==Unique items==
{{See also |List of unique armours granting evasion}}

===Notable evasion rating===
These unique items can potentially grant upwards of 1,000 evasion rating.

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|where=armours.evasion_range_maximum>999
|large=1
|level=1
|ev=1
}}

===Global evasion increases===
These unique items grant increased global evasion rating.

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=(item_stats.id LIKE "%evasion_rating_+\%%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%global_defences_+\%%") AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%local%"
|large=1
|stat=1
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=+% to global evasion Rating
|stat_column1_format=%s%%
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=evasion_rating+%
|stat_column1_stat2_id=global_defences_+%
}}

===Global flat evasion===
These unique items grant a global flat bonus to evasion rating.

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%base_evasion_rating%" AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%local%"
|large=1
|stat=1
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=+ to evasion rating
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=base_evasion_rating
}}

===Evasion chance===
These unique items grant additional chance to evade attacks.

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%chance_to_evade%"
|large=1
|stat=1
|level=1
}}

  mod_stats.id LIKE "%evasion%"
  AND mod_spawn_weights.tag = "dex_armour"

|spawn_weights=1
|generation_type=1

==Passive skills==
There are [[passive skill]]s that grant evasion bonuses.

===Evasion rating===
These passive skills grant increased evasion rating or additional base evasion rating.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "evasion_rating_+%"
}}

===Evasion rating and armour===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "evasion_and_physical_damage_reduction_rating_+%"
}}
===Miscellany===
These passive skills are related to evasion, but do not fit into any other category. 

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%evasion%"
  AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("evasion_rating_+%", "evasion_and_physical_damage_reduction_rating_+%")
  AND passive_skills.id NOT LIKE "affliction%"
}}
===Keystones===
{{Query keystone passive skills
|where=
  passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Evasion%"
  OR passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Evade%"
}}

===Masteries===
The following [[Passive Mastery|Masteries]] are related to evasion:
{{Query masteries}}

===Ascendancy passive skills===
{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=
  passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Evasion%"
  OR passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Evade%"
}}

===Cluster jewel passives===
The following [[cluster jewel]]-only passives are related to evasion:
{{Passive skill table
|q_where=
  passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%"
  AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%evasion%"
|large=1
|stat_text=1
}}

===Tattoos===
{{Drop enabled item table
|tables = tattoos
|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
|where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency"
  AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL
  AND items.description LIKE "%evasion%"
|large=1
|description=1
}}

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.16.0|
* Improved the Evasion formula to grant more chance to evade for all values of Evasion Rating. 
* Increased modifiers on gear that add base local Evasion Rating, and smoothed the progression of tiers.
* Evasion provided by base types can now be 15% higher on average, as part of a variable base type system. 
* Reworked Evasion passives.
* Adjusted monster base Evasion and Minion Accuracy to compensate for changes to the evasion formula.
* Monsters with abilities that always hit have been reviewed as a result of the removal of Dodge. Abilities that were deemed an issue no longer always hit, such as Fractal Gargantuan’s Slam, Rigwald, the Wolven King’s Barrage, Daresso, King of Swords’ Reave, and Guardian of the Chimera’s Combo and Charged Attacks. 
* Additional chance to Evade modifiers were discontinued from all Rare modifiers, passives and Pantheon powers as their values were generally too low or felt out of place and so that Vaal Grace could provide a very large value of this stat.
** Vaal Grace no longer has 24-34% Chance to Dodge Attack Hits or Spell Hits. Instead, it now has +15% Chance to Evade Attack Hits, and “Suppressed Spell Damage dealt to you is Unlucky”.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.7.0|
* Accuracy is no longer capped to a 95% chance to hit. With enough accuracy, an enemy will never be able to evade an attack, so you will no longer have lone surviving monster frustratingly taunting you (unless you didn't get enough accuracy!).
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.5|
* Improved evasion rating by 25% around the board. This brings it in line with previous changes to [[energy shield]] and damage reduction ([[armour]]). 
}}
{{Version history table row|0.5.10|
* Prevented area of effect damage from being evaded.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.5.3|
* Evasion/Damage balance
}}
{{Version history table row|0.5.2|
* Evasion balance changes.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
